hotelOccupancyNotes: Rough estimate of how full downtown hotels are, as it bears on each day (within about 10 points); not from STR data. Each day blends 60% of the night before (guests who woke up in town, including those checking out and shopping before they leave) with 40% of that night (arrivals, who mostly come in the afternoon or evening). Nights are built from the day of the week, the season, conventions in town, the night before cruise departures, and big events (Saints games, WWE); Halloween weekend is set from last year's ~90%. The total is the month's average.
